priority_items.title: Fiji CRC tabling clock set; NFP will not rush; report still unpublished
priority_items.summary: Speaker Jitoko confirmed a 22 Sep 11:30 special sitting to table the CRC Report 2026. NFP leader Prasad (FBC 17:08 FJT) will not support a rushed amendment of the 2013 Constitution; draft Bill feedback from NFP Cabinet reps still outstanding; GE-by-6 Feb 2027 clock should not accelerate reform. Lal/CDD autogolpe line remains conditional on electoral-system change delaying the GE. fiji.gov.fj still has no CRC item and no HIV Legal Notice. Not extra-constitutional. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: PMMM-4 named close-out; official PDF still unpublished ~23 h later
priority_items.summary: PACNEWS 17 Sep SPREP reprint: PMMM-4 concluded Wednesday with the Siu-i-Alaimoana Ki Likutapu Declaration; Fakafanua named Chair and Weather Ready Champion. pacificmet.net remains programme-plus-draft and future tense. PINA now leads with Regenvanu MHEWS host-bid leftover (details flagged to PMC 2028). Tonga 17 Sep holiday in force. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: PNG Independence omits Panguna; Kundiawa clinician killing; 50 VUT recruits at Bomana
priority_items.summary: PMNEC Nogat lesman recap still omits Panguna/K11bn. NBC carries a 16 Sep Panguna landowner ceremony (not a licence). Near-cutoff: Dr Robert Waiye dies after alleged Kundiawa assault; seven in custody; 48h petition; hospital emergency-only two days. Vice ministers Kumura/Karipe sworn. NBC 16:00 PGT: 50 Vanuatu recruits, six months at Bomana — Kumul Vanua implementation, not a new pact. Goroka 9 at large still in body. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: Vanuatu Matui still request-only; cargo-only CLAIM; 55/39 is not a SITREP
priority_items.summary: Confirmed band unchanged: 2 dead / 14 survivors. VMSA complaint still seeks Master arrest under s.108 — Daily Post request-only, HTTP 200. RNZ: Napuati says cargo-only, 10 Sep overflow warning; charges sought not executed. Daily Post 55/39 still '8 hrs ago' CLAIM. VFSC no Tui extract. China US$100k remains cash not a pact. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: Wale UNGA notice aging without wheels-up; AUS–SLB still unsigned
priority_items.summary: PMO via Island Sun: Wale departs Wednesday 16 Sep for UNGA-81. Article still future-tense at 18:00 Thursday 17 Sep SBT. SIBC 403. DFAT pages timed out; last confirmed language still 3 Jun 'commence negotiations.' No New York signature copy. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: Burke migration package still PALM-unnamed; Labour NZeTA is opposition policy
priority_items.summary: Burke NPC (~12:30 AEST) NOM/integrity package; Guardian/SMH do not name PALM/PEV; Home Affairs speeches URL 404. RNZ: Sepuloni promises three-month NZeTA for Forum countries if government changes — opposition policy, not a gazette. Penrhyn Novelly exclusive remains RSS #1; not a base. CSIS AUKUS at Five panel is after this cutoff (12:00 UTC). Not FLASH.
